name: Are there specific considerations for pathway clearance in smaller Bay Area homes?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific considerations for pathway clearance in smaller Bay Area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, smaller homes common in the Bay Area require careful planning for pathway clearance. Optimizing furniture scale, using multi-functional pieces, and strategic placement become critical. Utilizing vertical space, choosing lighter-profile furniture, and avoiding excessive decor can help maintain open pathways. Custom solutions like built-ins can also maximize floor space while ensuring adequate clearance in compact living areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smaller Bay Area homes need careful planning: optimize furniture scale, use multi-functional pieces, and consider custom solutions to maintain open pathways.
